author: Fuelle
body:
Okay, I was banned quite a while ago, 6 months to be exact. Here are the required details:
Name - Fuelle [formerly FirstAm]
Reason Banned - Flyhacking
I believe this ban is in fact a mistake. I recall that the moderator said something about having a toggle and shortly after I was banned without even being able to ask what they meant. Apparently they thought I was flying or something however I do understand why this mistake could have been made. During the time I was banned I did not have a good internet provider and I was lagging/'slingshotting' very frequently. Some days, it worked better than others. Anyway if my ban could be repealed that would be much appreciated. Thanks.
